summary:
Frontend-only E2E verification of iteration_8 auto-trigger fix in /app/frontend/app/(sales)/transaction/[id].tsx. Change under test: useState(autoSent) replaced with useRef(autoSentRef); useEffect deps trimmed to [t, autoSendWA]. 

RESULT: FIX VERIFIED — auto-trigger NOW FIRES.

[E2E — GALLON PATH, auto-trigger] Mobile viewport 390x844, login A1/sales123, navigated to /transaction/new?customer_id=<Budi 7d3b65bf-...>, tapped plus twice on Air Galon 19L (product 40492556-3ac2-4c48-bd53-72eea2a557c0), filled bayar-input=40000, tapped save-wa-btn. URL redirected to /transaction/{id}?autoSendWA=1 ✓. After ~900ms delay + html-to-image capture time, instrumented side-effects observed via page.add_init_script: 1 navigator.clipboard.writeText call AND 1 HTMLAnchorElement.click with download='OXLY-Nota-Budi.png'. This matches the web fallback path in shareShotWithText (image download + clipboard) since navigator.canShare(files) is not supported in headless Chromium. Auto-trigger successfully invoked resendWA without user interaction.

[Clipboard content check] Auto-triggered clipboard payload contains: '*Air OXLY*', 'Sales: A1', 'Pelanggan: Budi (No.1)', '*Pembelian:*', '• Air Galon 19L — 2 gln × Rp 20.000 = Rp 40.000', 'Total: Rp 40.000', 'Bayar: Rp 40.000', 'Sisa hutang: Rp 0', 'Total pinjam galon: 2 gln', 'Terima kasih 🙏'. Verified: NO 'Nomor Undian' text, NO ticket codes — matches formatReceipt no-lottery-text refactor from iter_8.

[Manual resend-wa-btn regression] After auto-fire, side-effect counters reset and manual tap on resend-wa-btn → 1 clipboard write + 1 anchor download. Still works (autoSentRef guards only the automatic path, not manual).

[NON-GALLON REGRESSION] New transaction with Cup 150ml (unit=box), tap Kirim WA & Simpan → URL redirected to /transaction/{id} WITHOUT '?autoSendWA=1' ✓. Exactly 1 window.open to https://wa.me/6281234567890?text=... containing 'Pembelian:' and NO 'Nomor Undian'. 0 clipboard writes, 0 downloads — correct text-only path via sendWhatsApp deep-link.

[TicketCard rendering] Detail page renders TicketCard inside ViewShot (nativeID='oxly-ticket-card-shot') with 2 tickets visible (Kartu Undian (2)). All 3 testIDs present: save-ticket-card-btn, share-ticket-card-btn, resend-wa-btn.

CONCLUSION: The useRef fix is correct. The iter_8 bug is FULLY RESOLVED. No new regressions.

action_items: No action items — auto-trigger fix verified working end-to-end. Feature complete.
critical_code_review_comments: [id].tsx:23 — `const autoSentRef = useRef(false);` correctly replaces state. No re-render on flip.

[id].tsx:102-112 — useEffect deps [t, autoSendWA] no longer includes the sent-flag. `if (autoSentRef.current || autoSendWA !== '1') return;` guard is idempotent. `autoSentRef.current = true;` set synchronously before setTimeout, so any incidental re-run (e.g., if `t` refetches on focus) is guarded. Cleanup clearTimeout is retained but safe because deps do not change during the 900ms window in normal usage.
[id].tsx:107-109 — 900ms delay before calling resendWA() is sufficient for ViewShot / html-to-image to paint the ticket card. Empirically verified: capture succeeds first time in web.

[id].tsx:47-99 — resendWA branches on lottery_tickets.length > 0 correctly. For gallon path (with tickets), calls shareShotWithText → on web falls back to download+clipboard (verified). For non-gallon (via new.tsx doSave path) uses sendWhatsApp → wa.me deep link (verified).
new.tsx:127-133 — Redirect to /transaction/[id]?autoSendWA=1 when saved.lottery_tickets.length > 0. Verified live.
new.tsx:134-155 — Non-gallon fallback still uses sendWhatsApp for text-only. Verified live.
